Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ,

Blood Weakens is in play.

a - In combat, I play Infernal Pursuit.
My hand becomes empty [during the same combat].
Does Blood Weakens make me draw [handsize] cards simultaneously, or do
I proceed card by card?
Since I've played Infernal Pursuit, replacing card by card would make
me discard one of the two cards drawn before replacing the next.

b - Does Blood Weaken's "do not replace discipline cards played
by[...]" affect cards played in a non-normal way ?
Examples: Pack Alpha (not replaced) + Raven Spy, Conceald Weapon +
Tinglestripe

c - I play Rewind Time to cancel someone else's Master card. Do I
replace immediately ?

Thanks

~ ~

Blood Weakens
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Cards minions play that require any Disciplines are not replaced until
the end of the current action or until any Methuselah's hand is empty
(whichever comes first). Any vampire who commits diablerie is immune
to this effect until the next Gehenna card is played.

Infernal Pursuit
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] For the remainder of the combat, each time you replace a card
(including when you draw to replace this card), draw an additional
card and discard down to your hand size.

Pack Alpha
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Animalism
A vampire may play only one Pack Alpha each round.
[ani] {This vampire employs} an animal retainer from your hand before
range is determined. Pay cost as normal.
[ANI] Burn an animal retainer employed by this vampire and put this
card on this vampire. The minion with this card gets +1 strength. A
minion may have only one Pack Alpha.

Rewind Time
Cardtype: Reaction
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Temporis/Presence
[pre] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[tem] Cancel an action card as it is played (the acting minion is not
tapped).
[TEM] Usable by a ready, untapped vampire even though there is no
action. Cancel a non-out-of-turn master card as it is played during
any other Methuselah's master phase (no cost is paid). The Methuselah
who played that card gains another master phase action.
